verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ በሳምንት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ጸውዖሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወለአእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel,

translations.lxx: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
translations.ron: Iar în ziua a opta a chemat Moise pe Aaron, pe fiii lui şi pe bătrânii lui Israel,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ, ἐκάλεσε Μωυσῆς Ἀαρὼν, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν γερουσίαν Ἰσραὴλ,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡ ላህመ ፡ እምነ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወበግዐ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡
                  ወአምጽኦሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: and Moses said to Aaron, Take to thyself a young calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a whole-burnt-offering, unblemished, and offer them before the Lord.

translations.lxx: and Moses said to Aaron, Take to thyself a young calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a whole-burnt-offering, unblemished, and offer them before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi a zis către Aaron: "Ia-ţi din turmă un viţel de jertfă pentru păcat şi un berbec pentru arderea de tot, amândoi fără meteahnă, şi-i adu înaintea feţei Domnului.
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ἀαρών, λάβε σεαυτῷ μοσχάριον ἐκ βοῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ κριὸν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα, ἄμωμα, καὶ προσένεγκε αὐτὰ ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወንግሮሙ ፡ ለአእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ አሐደ ፡ እምአጣሊ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወበግዐ ፡
                  ወላህመ ፡ ወማሕስአ ፡ ዘዓመት ፡ ንጹሓነ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And speak to the elders of Israel, saying, Take one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, and a young calf, and a lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering, spotless,

translations.lxx: And speak to the elders of Israel, saying, Take one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, and a young calf, and a lamb of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering, spotless,
translations.kjv: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
translations.ron: Iar bătrânilor lui Israel să le grăieşti şi să le spui: Luaţi din turma de capre un ţap, ca jertfă pentru păcat, un berbec, un viţel şi un miel, toţi de un an şi fără meteahnă, ca să fie aduşi ardere de tot,
translations.grk: Καὶ τῇ γερουσίᾳ Ἰσραὴλ λάλησον, λέγων, λάβετε χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ μοσχάριον, καὶ ἀμνὸν ἐνιαύσιον εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν, ἄμωμα,

verses.geez:
ወላህመኒ ፡ እምአልህምት ፡ ወበግዐኒ ፡ ለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወስንዳሌ ፡ ዘልውስ ፡ በቅብእ
                  ፡ እስመ ፡ ዮም ፡ ያስተርኢ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: and a calf and a ram for a peace offering before the Lord, and fine flour mingled with oil, for to-day the Lord will appear among you.

translations.lxx: and a calf and a ram for a peace offering before the Lord, and fine flour mingled with oil, for to-day the Lord will appear among you.
translations.kjv: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
translations.ron: Precum şi un bou şi un berbec pentru jertfă de mântuire, ca să se săvârşească jertfă înaintea feţei Domnului, şi prinos de pâine, frământat cu untdelemn, că astăzi are să vi se arate Domnul".
translations.grk: καὶ μόσχον, καὶ κριὸν εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ σεμίδαλιν πεφυραμένην ἐν ἐλαίῳ· ὅτι σήμερον Κύριος ὀφθήσεται ἐν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኡ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ ወቆመ ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And they took as Moses commanded them before the tabernacle of witness, and all the congregation drew nigh, and they stood before the Lord.

translations.lxx: And they took as Moses commanded them before the tabernacle of witness, and all the congregation drew nigh, and they stood before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
translations.ron: Deci au luat ei şi au adus înaintea cortului adunării cele ce poruncise Moise şi a venit toată obştea şi a stat înaintea feţei Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβον καθὸ ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ἀπέναντι τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου· καὶ προσῆλθε πᾶσα συναγωγὴ, καὶ ἔστησαν ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ዘይቤለክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ግበሩ ፡ ወያስተርኢ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord has spoken; do it, and the glory of the Lord shall appear among you.

translations.lxx: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord has spoken; do it, and the glory of the Lord shall appear among you.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Moise către obşte: "Iată ce a poruncit Domnul să faceţi, ca să vi se arate slava Domnului!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς, τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα, ὃ εἶπε Κύριος, ποιήσατε, καὶ ὀφθήσεται ἐν ὑμῖν ἡ δόξα Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ሑር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትከ ፡ ወዘመሥዋዕትከ ፡ ወአስተስሪ ፡
                  ለርእስከ ፡ ወለቤትከ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ግበር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ዘሕዝብ ፡ ወአስተስሪ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, Draw nigh to the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy whole-burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for thy house; and offer the gifts of the people, and make atonement for them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, Draw nigh to the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy whole-burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for thy house; and offer the gifts of the people, and make atonement for them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
translations.ron: Iar către Aaron Moise a zis: "Apropie-te de jertfelnic şi săvârşeşte jertfa ta cea pentru păcat şi arderea de tot a ta şi curăţeşte-te pe tine şi casa ta; apoi adu darurile poporului şi-l curăţeşte, cum a poruncit Domnul!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς τῷ Ἀαρὼν, πρόσελθε πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ποίησον τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας σου, καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμά σου, καὶ ἐξίλασαι περὶ σεαυτοῦ, καὶ τοῦ οἴκου σου· καὶ ποίησον τὰ δῶρα τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐξίλασαι περὶ αὐτῶν, καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወሖረ ፡ አሮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወጠብሐ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron drew nigh to the altar, and slew the calf of his sin-offering.

translations.lxx: And Aaron drew nigh to the altar, and slew the calf of his sin-offering.
translations.kjv: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
translations.ron: Deci, s-a apropiat Aaron de jertfelnic şi a junghiat viţelul cel de jertfă pentru păcatul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσῆλθεν Ἀαρὼν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἔσφαξε τὸ μοσχάριον τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ደሞ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወጠምዐ ፡ አጽባዕቶ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቅርንተ ፡
                  ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወከዐወ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምንባረ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and he poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and he poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Aaron, aducând sângele la el, şi-a muiat degetul în sânge şi a pus pe coarnele jertfelnicului, iar celălalt sânge l-a turnat jos lângă jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν τὸ αἷμα πρὸς αὐτόν· καὶ ἔβαψε τὸν δάκτυλον εἰς τὸ αἷμα, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὰ κέρατα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου· καὶ τὸ αἷμα ἐξέχεεν ἐπὶ τὴν βάσιν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወሥብሖሰ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ ኵለያቲሁ ፡ ወከብዶ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእስ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡
                  በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And he offered up on the altar the fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver of the sin-offering, according as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And he offered up on the altar the fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver of the sin-offering, according as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Grăsimea, rărunchii şi seul de pe ficat, de la jertfa cea pentru păcat, le-a ars pe jertfelnic, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ στέαρ καὶ τοὺς νεφροὺς καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ἥπατος τοῦ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἀνήνεγκεν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወሥጋሁሰ ፡ ወማእሶ ፡ አውዐዩ ፡ በእሳት ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire outside of the camp.

translations.lxx: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire outside of the camp.
translations.kjv: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
translations.ron: Iar carnea şi pielea le-a ars pe foc afară din tabără.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ κρέα καὶ τὴν βύρσαν κατέκαυσεν αὐτὰ πυρὶ, ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς.

verses.geez: ወጠብሐ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕትኒ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ወከዐዎ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And he slew the whole-burnt-offering; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it on the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And he slew the whole-burnt-offering; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it on the altar round about.
translations.kjv: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
translations.ron: Apoi a junghiat jertfa cea pentru arderea de tot şi, aducându-i fiii lui Aaron sângele, a stropit jertfelnicul din toate părţile.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσφαξε τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα· καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν τὸ αἷμα πρὸς αὐτόν· καὶ προσέχεεν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ.

verses.geez: ወመሥዋዕቶኒ ፡ አምጽኡ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በበመለያልይሁ ፡ ወርእሶኒ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And they brought the whole-burnt-offering, according to its pieces; them and the head he put upon the altar.

translations.lxx: And they brought the whole-burnt-offering, according to its pieces; them and the head he put upon the altar.
translations.kjv: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
translations.ron: După aceea i-au adus arderea de tot în bucăţi şi el le-a pus împreună cu căpăţâna pe jertfelnic,
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα προσήνεγκαν αὐτὸ κατὰ μέλη· αὐτὰ καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez: [ወኀፀበ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ውስጡ ፡ ወእገሪሁ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡] ዲበ ፡ መሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And he washed the belly and the feet with water, and he put them on the whole-burnt-offering on the altar.

translations.lxx: And he washed the belly and the feet with water, and he put them on the whole-burnt-offering on the altar.
translations.kjv: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
translations.ron: Iar măruntaiele şi picioarele le-a spălat cu apă şi le-a pus peste arderea de tot şi le-a ars pe jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔπλυνε τὴν κοιλίαν καὶ τοὺς πόδας ὕδατι· καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ አብአ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ወነሥኦ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ዘሕዝብ ፡ ወጠብሖ ፡
                  ወአንጽሖ ፡ ወመተሮ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘቀዳሚ ።
verses.translation: And he brought the gift of the people, and took the goat of the sin-offering of the people, and slew it, and purified it as also the first.

translations.lxx: And he brought the gift of the people, and took the goat of the sin-offering of the people, and slew it, and purified it as also the first.
translations.kjv: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
translations.ron: Apoi a adus prinosul poporului: luând ţapul cel pentru păcatul poporului l-a junghiat şi l-a adus jertfă pentru păcat, ca şi berbecul.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκε τὸ δῶρον τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἔλαβε τὸν χίμαρον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἔσφαξεν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἐκαθάρισεν αὐτὸν, καθὰ καὶ τὸν πρῶτον.

verses.geez: ወአብአ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወገብሮ ፡ በሕጉ ።
verses.translation: And he brought the whole-burnt-offering, and offered it in due form.

translations.lxx: And he brought the whole-burnt-offering, and offered it in due form.
translations.kjv: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
translations.ron: După aceea a adus arderea de tot, săvârşind-o după rânduială.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκε τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα, καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὸ ὡς καθήκει.

verses.geez: ወአምጽ[አ] ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ መልአ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ዘነግህ ።
verses.translation: And he brought the sacrifice and filled his hands with it, and laid it on the altar, besides the morning whole-burnt-offering.

translations.lxx: And he brought the sacrifice and filled his hands with it, and laid it on the altar, besides the morning whole-burnt-offering.
translations.kjv: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
translations.ron: A adus de asemenea prinos de pâine şi, luând din el o mână plină, a ars pe jertfelnic, pe lângă arderea de tot cea de dimineaţă.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκε τὴν θυσίαν, καὶ ἔπλησε τὰς χεῖρας ἀπʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον χωρὶς τοῦ ὁλοκαυτώματος τοῦ πρωϊνοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ጠብሐ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ወበግዐ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ዘሕዝብ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ደሞ ፡ ኀቤሁ
                  ፡ ወከዐዎ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፤
verses.translation: And he slew the calf, and the ram of the sacrifice of peace-offering of the people; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it out on the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And he slew the calf, and the ram of the sacrifice of peace-offering of the people; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it out on the altar round about.
translations.kjv: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
translations.ron: Apoi a junghiat boul şi berbecul pentru jertfa de mântuire a poporului şi fiii lui Aaron i-au adus sângele şi el a stropit cu el jertfelnicul de jur împrejur.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσφαξε τὸν μόσχον, καὶ τὸν κριὸν τῆς θυσίας τοῦ σωτηρίου τῆς τοῦ λαοῦ· καὶ προσήνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν τὸ αἷμα πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ προσέχεε πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ,

verses.geez:
ወሥብሐ ፡ ዘላህምኒ ፡ ወዘበግዕኒ ፡ ወሐቌሁ ፡ ወሥብሐ ፡ ዘይገለብባ ፡ ለከርሡ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ ኵለያቲሁ ፡ ወሥብሐ ፡
                  ዘላዕሌሆን ፡ ወከብዶ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእስ ።
verses.translation: And he took the fat of the calf, and the hind quarters of the ram, and the fat covering the belly, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and the caul on the liver.

translations.lxx: And he took the fat of the calf, and the hind quarters of the ram, and the fat covering the belly, and the two kidneys, and the fat upon them, and the caul on the liver.
translations.kjv: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
translations.ron: I-au adus apoi grăsimea boului şi a berbecului, coada şi grăsimea cea de pe măruntaie, rărunchii cu grăsimea lor şi grăsimea de pe ficat;
translations.grk: καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ μόσχου, καὶ τοῦ κριοῦ τὴν ὀσφὺν, καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ κατακαλύπτον ἐπὶ τῆς κοιλίας, καὶ τοὺς δύο νεφροὺς, καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἥπατος.

verses.geez: ወአንበረ ፡ ሥብሖ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ተላዕ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And he put the fat on the breasts, and offered the fat on the altar.

translations.lxx: And he put the fat on the breasts, and offered the fat on the altar.
translations.kjv: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
translations.ron: şi a pus grăsimea pe pieptul jertfei de izbăvire, apoi a ars grăsimea pe jertfelnic;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέθηκε τὰ στέατα ἐπὶ τὰ στηθύνια καὶ ἀνήνεγκε τὰ στέατα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez:
ወተላዐ ፡ ወአገዳ ፡ ዘየማን ፡ መተረ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ሀብቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ለሙሴ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Aaron separated the breast and the right shoulder as a choice-offering before the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Aaron separated the breast and the right shoulder as a choice-offering before the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
translations.ron: Iar pieptul şi spata dreaptă le-a adus Aaron legănându-le înaintea feţei Domnului, cum poruncise Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ στηθύνιον, καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν δεξιὸν ἀφεῖλεν Ἀαρὼν ἀφαίρεμα ἔναντι Κυρίου, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወአልዐለ ፡ አሮን ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወባረኮሙ ፡ ወወረደ ፡ ገቢሮ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወዘመሥዋዕት ፡
                  ወዘመድኀኒት ።
verses.translation: And Aaron lifted up his hands on the people and blessed them; and after he had offered the sin-offering, and the whole-burnt-offerings, and the peace-offerings, he came down.

translations.lxx: And Aaron lifted up his hands on the people and blessed them; and after he had offered the sin-offering, and the whole-burnt-offerings, and the peace-offerings, he came down.
translations.kjv: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
translations.ron: Şi şi-a ridicat Aaron mâinile sale asupra poporului şi l-a binecuvântat, iar după ce a săvârşit jertfa pentru păcat, arderea de tot şi jertfa de mântuire, s-a coborât.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξάρας Ἀαρὼν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν, εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς· καὶ κατέβη ποιήσας τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα, καὶ τὰ τοῦ σωτηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወቦኡ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወወፂኦሙ ፡ ባረክዎ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወአስተርአየ ፡
                  ስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron entered into the tabernacle of witness. And they came out and blessed all the people, and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron entered into the tabernacle of witness. And they came out and blessed all the people, and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
translations.ron: Apoi au intrat Moise şi Aaron în cortul adunării şi când au ieşit au binecuvântat tot poporul; atunci s-a arătat slava Domnului la tot poporul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθε Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου· καὶ ἐξελθόντες εὐλόγησαν πάντα τὸν λαὸν· καὶ ὤφθη δόξα Κυρίου παντὶ τῷ λαῷ.

verses.geez:
ወወፅአት ፡ እሳት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበልዐት ፡ መሥዋዕቶ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወሥብሐኒ ፡ ወርእዮ ፡ ኵሉ
                  ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወደንገፀ ፡ ወወድቁ ፡ በገጾሙ ።
verses.translation: And fire came forth from the Lord, and devoured the offerings on the altar, both the whole-burnt-offerings and the fat; and all the people saw, and were amazed, and fell upon their faces.

translations.lxx: And fire came forth from the Lord, and devoured the offerings on the altar, both the whole-burnt-offerings and the fat; and all the people saw, and were amazed, and fell upon their faces.
translations.kjv: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
translations.ron: Şi ieşind foc de la Domnul, a mistuit pe jertfelnic arderea de tot şi grăsimea. Şi văzând tot poporul a scos strigăte de bucurie şi a căzut cu faţa la pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθε πῦρ παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ κατέφαγε τὰ ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, τά τε ὁλοκαυτώματα, καὶ τὰ στέατα· καὶ εἶδε πᾶς ὁ λαὸς, καὶ ἐξέστη, καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον.
